title: WP900 G9 semantic-content causality must preregister an outcome-independent semantic oracle
target: F2-WP-900 generation 9 semantic content causality crossover

material_observation.g9_strength: G9 correctly requires a same-mechanism content crossover, condition-blind downstream observation, representation controls and exact lineage before any semantic promotion.
material_observation.remaining_confound: Those controls do not by themselves prove that the semantic equivalence/difference relation was fixed independently of the observed A/B outcomes. If the semantic comparator, canonicalizer, class mapping, expected-outcome relation or acceptance threshold is selected or revised after seeing treatment outcomes, the experiment can manufacture a semantic-content association from ordinary surface differences or noise.
material_observation.scope_risk: A post-hoc or outcome-dependent semantic oracle makes semantic-content causality circular: the same evidence being tested helps define what counts as the semantic effect.

falsifier_hypothesis: G9 semantic-content causal evidence is underidentified unless treatment-semantic classes, outcome-semantic equivalence, expected direction and acceptance thresholds are frozen before execution and their construction is independent of treatment assignment and observed downstream outcomes.
counterhypothesis: A condition-blind runtime observer is sufficient even if the semantic comparator or class mapping is chosen after the run. This is false because blindness during observation does not prevent post-hoc relabeling or comparator selection during analysis.

executable_counterexample.setup: Generate two payloads A/B and downstream outcomes whose raw forms differ but whose task-relevant meaning is ambiguous under several plausible normalizers. After observing the A/B outputs, choose the normalizer or semantic field projection that maximizes separation. The condition-blind observer remains formally blind, yet the analysis reports a stable semantic A/B effect that disappears under another equally admissible pre-run comparator.

preregistration: Freeze a versioned semantic-oracle contract before trial execution: input schema, canonical field projection, equivalence relation, invalid/unknown handling, expected treatment contrast and acceptance threshold.
Bind the oracle source/blob hash and configuration into the exact trial plan before treatment assignment or downstream outcome generation.
The oracle implementation and configuration must not receive treatment labels, order positions, observed outcomes, aggregate pass/fail state or adaptive thresholds while defining semantic classes.
independence_controls: Run semantic-oracle classification on preregistered fixture pairs before the causal trials, including semantically equal surface variants and semantically distinct near-neighbors.
Include at least one alternate representation of each semantic class that must map identically under the frozen oracle.
Include hard negatives where raw/hash difference exists without semantic difference and where semantic difference exists with minimal surface difference.

Any oracle/schema/config change after outcome observation invalidates the current causal analysis and requires a new generation or explicitly fresh preregistered experiment rather than reinterpreting the same run.
lineage: Bind trial-plan hash, oracle source/blob hash, oracle config hash, payload semantic-class receipts, downstream semantic-class receipts, treatment assignment, process identities and raw outcome hashes.
Preserve UNKNOWN when the frozen oracle cannot classify an outcome; do not broaden equivalence post hoc to make a trial pass.

hard_negatives: oracle/config modified after any treatment outcome is observed -> EVIDENCE_INVALID_POSTHOC_ORACLE
two equally admitted pre-run semantic projections produce opposite causal classifications -> SEMANTIC_IDENTIFIABILITY_UNKNOWN
semantic class depends on treatment label or order -> ORACLE_TREATMENT_LEAK
surface-only difference becomes semantic difference under selected field projection -> REPRESENTATION_CONFOUND_NOT_SEMANTIC_CAUSALITY
unknown outcome is remapped into expected class after the run -> POSTHOC_SCOPE_INFLATION
promotion_rule: G9 may earn only the narrowest semantic-content candidate supported by a pre-run frozen, treatment/outcome-independent semantic oracle. Semantic GWT/J-Space promotion remains zero unless the causal path controls also pass in target execution.
next_exact_action: Do not duplicate or mutate G9 from this reviewer lane. The active G9 owner should bind a preregistered outcome-independent semantic-oracle contract and its hard negatives before repository acceptance, or explicitly narrow G9 to non-semantic content-difference evidence.
